name: What maintenance is required for rain shower systems?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for rain shower systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintaining a rain shower system typically involves regular cleaning to prevent mineral buildup, especially in areas with hard water, to ensure consistent spray patterns. Many modern rain shower heads feature silicone nozzles that can be easily wiped clean. It's also important to periodically check for any leaks around connections.
